description: Duplicate one or more existing records within a table. Creates exact copies of the specified source records in the same table and view. Returns the new record IDs.

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

sourceRowIds.description: Array of record IDs to duplicate (e.g. ["recXXX", "recYYY"])

tableId.description: The table ID containing the records to duplicate

viewId.description: The view ID to paste the duplicated records into

name: duplicate_records
